coupling.file: 02_人体骨骼晶格肌肉方案/输出/s1_local_muscle_load/FJ1500_cap_relief/FJ1500_tpu_coupling_screen.json

scope: Baseline cap equilibria use a chord inequality. At each fixed resulting pose, independently fit a monotone cubic span tangent to both retained crimp leads. Minimum is a numerical result within that family. Assumed radii and installed lengths require calibration. Separate arc equilibrium uses one cubic with handle lengths fixed to one third of the chord, an arc length inequality and assumed bending energy; this is a reduced cable model. TPU contact, wire axial elasticity and full rod equilibrium are excluded.
